projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Python
description: PyPI packages for Python 3.10+. DeviceDetectionPipelineBuilder(data_file_path=path, auto_update=False) for on-premise or DeviceDetectionPipelineBuilder(resource_key=key) for the cloud, then .build(). Use with pipeline.create_flowdata() as data, data.evidence.add('header.user-agent', ua), data.process(), then data.device.ismobile.value(). IpIntelligencePipelineBuilder covers IP Intelligence. fiftyone_pipeline_did reads 51Did. Install with pip install fiftyone-devicedetection
